t: You're on Praed Street in Paddington, a straight road running south-west from Edgware Road. It's best known for London Paddington station and St Mary's Hospital, both on this street. Buses run along it, though east of Norfolk Place the street is one-way eastbound. The name comes from William Praed, an English businessman, banker and politician. He sat in the House of Commons from 1774 to 1808, and his name is the one the street carries.
